caption: A device raises an IRQ, the CPU enters through the IDT, do_IRQ runs the top half, then softirqs, tasklets or workqueues finish the slower work. The top half runs immediately with interrupts disabled.

spec.title: Interrupt path
spec.aria: Blocks show a device raising an IRQ through an IDT entry to do_IRQ, then top half, with parallel outputs to softirq or tasklet and to workqueue.
